call_events_no_public_url.title: Call events need Home Assistant on the internet
call_events_no_public_url.description:
Tel2 sends call events straight to Home Assistant, so it needs an address it can reach from the internet. Either sign in to Home Assistant Cloud, or set an external URL starting with https under Settings > System > Network.

Once Home Assistant is reachable this clears by itself within about 15 minutes, or reload the Tel2 integration to apply it straight away. Until then the call event entities stay unavailable. Everything else still works.

set_line_setting.name: Set line setting
set_line_setting.description: Sets any Tel2 line setting on a number, for settings that don't have their own entity. PINs and security answers can't be set.
